newsitem.title: USA: Bolivian Power agrees to NRG Energy buy.
newsitem.headline: Bolivian Power agrees to NRG Energy buy.

text.p: Bolivian Power Co Ltd said Thursday that it has agreed for a subsidiary of NRG Energy Inc to buy all its outstanding common stock at $43 per share.
Bolivian Power said the subsidiary, NRGenerating Holdings, will begin a cash tender offer for its shares next week.
Bolivian Power said the deal is valued at about $182 million. The company has about 4.3 million fully diluted shares outstanding, said Bolivian Power Chief Executive Lawrence Coben.
Expiration of the tender offer through NRGenerating Holdings No.9 BV will expire 20 days after it begins, Bolivian Power said.
